Product

Scrava

by Nextract

Amazon ASIN scraping, built to handle the hard parts.

We built Scrava to solve the proxy-management headache we faced in-house. Processed 2.3M+ Amazon ASINs with a 99.7% success rate. Handles CAPTCHAs, rotating proxies, and "Dog" page errors automatically.
